items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I had taken Dinah Shore there for dinner, for a date, we had a date there at that time. We were both single at the time.

ctx.x: That was where that happened, that specifically. I had taken Dinah Shore there for dinner, for a date, we had a date there at that time. We were both single at the time. And she thought the food was the best thing. Dinah was a little heavy at the time, but she was coming along.
You had one other story about Benny Goodman I wanted to ask you about.
